name: Platinum Salon
blurb: Platinum Salon is a hair salon in Tampa’s New Tampa area, serving Tampa Bay and nearby communities. Its services include custom color, blonding, balayage, highlights, color correction, precision cuts for women and men, smoothing treatments, extensions, and men’s hair toppers and hair loss solutions. The salon is led by Artistic Director Allen Coleman, whose experience includes color, cutting, education, and extensions.
